prompt: Create a dark surreal gothic illustration of an abandoned amusement park seen through a huge jagged torn-paper or shattered-wall opening. The canvas is vertical, nearly square 4:5, with a centered composition and deep vignette shadows around the edges. In the midground, place exactly 3 major amusement rides: one large Ferris wheel slightly left of center with about 16 small enclosed gondolas, one tall roller coaster track on the right rising behind the scene, and one decaying carousel in the lower right foreground with a pointed canopy, ornate circular panels, thin poles, and several shadowy carousel horses. Add exactly 1 small ticket booth or kiosk in the lower left foreground, with a dark service window, scalloped awning trim, a round sign on top, and exactly 1 old streetlamp standing behind it. The foreground should show cracked wet pavement, scattered paper-like debris, broken slabs, railings on the right, bare leafless branches on the left and right, and tattered bunting hanging across the middle distance. Use a cold monochrome palette of charcoal, slate blue, ash gray, and misty white, with a pale foggy backlight glowing behind the Ferris wheel. Style it like a highly detailed matte painting mixed with textured oil paint and paper collage: visible brush strokes, rough plaster texture, layered torn edges, cinematic atmospheric perspective, eerie silence, no people, no animals beyond carousel horses, no readable text, no watermark. Overall mood: haunting, abandoned, melancholic; setting: ruined gothic amusement park; color palette: charcoal gray, slate blue, ash white; central ride: large Ferris wheel; lighting: pale misty backlight through fog.
